Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: November 18, 2026

1. Cancellation Policy

You can cancel your VultaCore subscription at any time directly through your account dashboard under Subscription Settings or via the customer portal link provided in your billing confirmation emails.

When you cancel a subscription:

  • Scheduled Cancellation: Your cancellation will take effect at the end of your current paid billing period. You will retain full access to your plan features until that date.
  • No Further Charges: You will not be billed for any subsequent billing periods after cancellation is scheduled.

2. 14-Day Refund Guarantee

We want you to be completely satisfied with VultaCore. If you are unsatisfied with your paid subscription for any reason, you may request a full refund within 14 days of your initial purchase or renewal date.

3. How to Request a Refund

Because our order processing is conducted by our online reseller and Merchant of Record, Paddle.com, refunds may be requested either through:

  • VultaCore Support: Email support@techprogression.com with your account email and Paddle order / transaction ID.
  • Paddle Buyer Support: Directly visit paddle.net using the email address used at checkout.

Approved refunds are processed back to the original payment method (Credit Card, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay) within 5–10 business days depending on your financial institution.

4. Exceptions

Refund requests submitted beyond the 14-day window or accounts terminated for violation of our Terms of Service (e.g., unlawful security attacks or abuse of developer APIs) are not eligible for refunds.

5. Contact Information

If you have any questions regarding cancellations or refunds:
